scope: Checked synchronous CPU int32 scalar literals, bindings, ordinary functions and exact executable results through MLIR/LLVM.

semantics.types: Explicit int32 scalar contexts alongside float32; no implicit int/float conversion. Unconstrained int64/float64 defaults remain unsupported rather than changing to int32.
semantics.literals: Precise integer parsing including signed minimum. Out-of-range and fractional/exponent int32 literals rejected with S051.
semantics.static_faults: S052 rejects known invalid literal/binding arithmetic and known zero divisors; no interprocedural constant evaluation.
semantics.runtime_arithmetic: Unary +/- and binary +,-,*,/,% preserve int32. Signed i64 intermediates are sufficient for every int32 operation; range checks precede narrowing.
semantics.division: Truncation toward zero; zero divisor checked before division/remainder. INT32_MIN/-1 faults; INT32_MIN%-1 is zero without overflowing division.
semantics.faults: Invocation arithmetic fault code 4, source span and checked-return propagation stop dependent execution; CLI reports ArithmeticFault and exits 86.
semantics.abi: Integer parameters/results and a separate typed int32 CLI entry preserve exact values. Existing float32 entry and memref ABI unchanged.
semantics.remaining: Integer tensors, CPU task continuations, Metal/GPU arithmetic, conversions and additional numerical types remain unsupported and explicitly gated.

coverage: int32 literal endpoints and signed minimum
known zero divisor with dynamic numerator
ordinary scalar calls and runtime forwarding wrappers
19x19 endpoint cross-product and 10000 deterministic random pairs per operation
dynamic overflow/divide-zero fault code, source line and nonzero source column
precise CLI results beyond float32 precision and at signed endpoints
preserved existing executable/IR on static rejection
complete existing CPU/Metal numerical, scheduler and lifetime regression
qualification.frontend_sanitizers: Frontend-only ASan/UBSan test links only sanitized syntax/semantic libraries; debug test additionally checks MLIR lowering.

initial_full_run.failure: native-unused-inputs-cli expected obsolete diagnostic wording; compiler rejected with correct S019 code and preserved outputs

regression.correction: Only legacy diagnostic assertion changed to stable S019 code; implementation unchanged. Header type comment also updated.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; separate design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Arithmetic correctness qualification, no speedup claim.
